verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions explicitly supports YAML-based CI/CD workflows compatible with GitHub Actions, directly matching the story, and community evidence (gitea-comm-8) confirms real-world use alongside Drone CI. However, most community discussion notes Gitea historically stayed focused on git hosting rather than bundling CI (gitea-comm-5), suggesting Actions is a newer/less battle-tested feature with limited independent validation in the evidence pack.
